sections.html:
• Drones come with rules: check FAA (US), CAA (UK) or EASA (EU) registration and flying rules before gifting.
  • Handheld PCs vs consoles: Steam Deck suits someone with a Steam library; Switch 2 suits Nintendo fans and families.
  • Desk upgrades (mouse, keyboard, charging stand) are low-risk gifts for anyone working from home.
